notes.title: Breaking News: "Kill the Twister" has received a patch
notes.content:
[h3]Update Alert: a patch has been reported in the local region[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508839/a4c6957d5c89e1397702cf2d84a477f5b1d57b89.png[/img]
Citizens have reported a number of small changes affecting weather patterns and user interaction in nearby games. Reported changes include:
[list]
[*] Tornado attacks are slightly more spaced out
[*] Whirls appear in smaller groups
[*] Moving while zoomed in will cancel the zoom
[*] Tutorial text lingers a bit longer
[*] Most recent tutorials and objectives are now displayed in the pause menu
[*] Added a "Very Easy" mode for those seeking a more chill experience
[*] Added a "Very Hard" mode for those seeking pain
[*] [spoiler]Added an arrow indicator to better warn the player of incoming meteors [/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Made it so meteor cant kill you when you have the bazooka[/spoiler] 
[*] Fixed the shotgun not firing the first time you click after picking it up
[/list]

Local advisory boards recommend immediate replays to ensure quality control. Further updates to be expected in the coming days.

Stay safe out there folks,
[i]-Channel 27 News [/i]

notes.title: Kill The Twister is now live!
notes.content:
[h2][h2]STORM ALERT: [/h2]A bite sized game featuring a massive tornado is coming your way! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508839/9f6d4646b2228c63fbdfe4e7b8dc8cb6267dd0b6.gif[/img]

I am very pleased to announce that "[i]Kill the Twister[/i]" is now available for free on Windows platforms! Designed as a ~30 minute boss fight, I hope that it serves as a fun challenge for FPS players old and new.

Mac builds are still a work in progress, but should hopefully be available within the next week or so. I'll be posting any relevant updates one my Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/jarkonian.bsky.social 

In the meantime, I'll be keeping an eye on the Steam and Itch pages for any bugs or news players have. With that said, please leave a review or post if you liked the game or have any feedback you'd want to send my way! We only need 10 reviews to get a massive boost from Steam, so any little comment helps.

Hope you all enjoy!

-Jakob
